title.description: Title of the post. Read by YouTube (video title, which YouTube needs), Facebook `video`, TikTok `image` and `album` (up to 90 characters), and Pinterest (pin title, cut to 100 characters). Other platforms ignore it, so send `""`.
title.title: Title

description.description: The caption, or the post text for `text`, where it is required. YouTube uses it as the video description and Pinterest as the pin description, cut to 800 characters. Shopee needs 1 to 150 characters. Not used by `story`.
description.title: Description

topic.description: Threads only: the topic tag shown on the post, for example `Social Media`. Send `""` for other platforms.
topic.title: Topic

type.description: The kind of post: `text`, `image`, `video`, `reel`, `album`, `link`, or `story`. It decides which `medias` are needed.
type.title: Type

medias.description: The images and videos of the post. `text` needs none, so send `[]`. `image` and `link` need 1 image, `video` and `reel` 1 video, `album` 2 or more, and `story` 1 image or video.
medias.title: Medias

meta.description: The shared link of a `link` post, where it is required. Other types can leave it out.
meta.title: Meta

additionalInfo.description: Options that only some platforms have, such as music, privacy, or the channel to post to. Required for Pinterest, which needs `additionalInfo.channel`.
additionalInfo.title: Additionalinfo

replies.description: Threads and X (Twitter) only: posts added under the main post as a thread, in order. Other platforms reject it with `400`, so send `[]`.
replies.title: Replies

scheduleAt.description: When to publish, as an ISO 8601 date and time with a time zone, for example `2026-06-01T12:00:00.000Z`. Due schedules are picked up every minute, so a time in the past is published within a minute.
scheduleAt.title: Scheduleat

templateId.description: ID of an automation template, the `_id` from Get Template. Its configuration is copied into the schedule when it is saved and set on the post after it is published. Not applied on Shopee, X (Twitter), or Pinterest.
templateId.title: Templateid

accountId.description: ID of the connected account to post to, the `_id` from Get Account. Its platform decides which fields are read. One schedule posts to one account, so create one for each account.
accountId.title: Accountid

at.description: When to follow up, as an ISO date and time in the future. Replaces the current follow-up.
at.title: At

note.description: What to follow up on, up to 500 characters. Can be empty.
note.title: Note

message.description: The message to send when following up, written ahead, up to 1000 characters. Repliz never sends it by itself; in the app it is sent with one click as a DM or a reply to the latest comment. Empty when left out.
message.title: Message

text.description: Text of the reply. Required, even when an `image` is attached. The comment is set to `resolved` after the reply is sent.
text.title: Text

image.description: An image posted together with `text`. Supported on Facebook, Threads, TikTok, LinkedIn and X (Twitter).
image.title: Image

type.description: Message type: `text`, `image`, `video`, `audio`, `document`, `button`, `carousel`, or `quick_reply`. It decides which of the other fields is read. `button`, `carousel`, and `quick_reply` work on Facebook and Instagram only.
type.title: Type

text.description: Message text, required for `text`. With `image`, `video`, or `document`, Telegram sends it as the caption.
text.title: Text

replyToMessageId.description: Send this message as a reply to an earlier message in the same chat: its `messageId` from Get Message. The platform shows that message quoted above this one, and the response of Get Message has it in `quoted`. Works with every type on Facebook, Instagram, and Telegram; TikTok replies are `text` only. Not a reply when left out.
replyToMessageId.title: Replytomessageid

ScheduleConfig.description:
Schedule configuration from the frontend widget.
Fields accept Union[int, str] to support drag-and-drop references like
{{nodeId.values.field}} which get resolved at configuration time.

daysOfWeek.description: Days of week to run on (0=Sunday … 6=Saturday); empty = every day. Supported for seconds/minutes/hours intervals and daily schedules.
daysOfWeek.title: Daysofweek

windowStart.description: Part-of-day start as 24-hour "HH:MM" in the schedule timezone (e.g. "09:00"). Set together with windowEnd; interval frequencies only.
windowStart.title: Windowstart

windowEnd.description: Part-of-day end as 24-hour "HH:MM", inclusive — a run landing exactly on it fires (e.g. "18:00" runs the 6:00 PM tick).
windowEnd.title: Windowend

monthDayStart.description: Part-of-month start day (1-31), inclusive. Set together with monthDayEnd; a start after the end wraps around month end (25→5 = the 25th through the 5th).
monthDayStart.title: Monthdaystart

monthStart.description: Part-of-year start month (1=January … 12=December), inclusive. Set together with monthEnd; a start after the end wraps around the new year (11→2 = November through February).
monthStart.title: Monthstart

ScheduleConfig.title: ScheduleConfig

alt.description: Alt text that describes the image for screen readers. Read by Instagram (`image` and `album`) and Pinterest (cut to 500 characters).
alt.title: Alt

customThumbnail.description: `true` makes Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube use `thumbnail` as the video cover. Otherwise the platform picks one. Default `false`.
customThumbnail.title: Customthumbnail

thumbnail.description: Cover image URL for a video. Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube use it only when `customThumbnail` is `true`. WhatsApp, Telegram, and Pinterest use it whenever it is set.
thumbnail.title: Thumbnail

url.description: Public URL of the file. The platform downloads it when the post is published, so it has to stay reachable until then. Files in Repliz Storage work everywhere.
url.title: Url

description.description: Text of the reply. Required for `text`.
description.title: Description

topic.description: Threads topic tag of the reply.
topic.title: Topic

medias.description: Media objects, with the same rules as the main post. Send `[]` for `text`.
medias.title: Medias

textAttachment.description: Threads `text` replies. A long text attached under the reply, read like an article, with the same rules as `additionalInfo.textAttachment` of the main post. Other types and X (Twitter) ignore it.
textAttachment.title: Textattachment

delay.description: Minutes to wait after the post before it (the main post for the first reply) is published. `0` or left out posts it right away. It can't be less than the `delay` of the reply before it, and all `delay` values together can't exceed `1440` (24 hours).
delay.title: Delay
